description: Render an Arc diagram as deterministic SVG markup using the package export path.

animateFlows.description: Embed SMIL flow animation in the SVG (default: true; ignored when flowTime is set)

backgroundColor.description: CSS background color (defaults to the theme canvas)

flowTime.description: Render flow markers at this route second (disables SMIL animation)

includeGrid.description: Render the diagram grid (default: branded themes on, others off)

mode.description: Color mode; defaults to the theme default

padding.description: Padding around the export bounds in px (default: 20)

theme.description: Arc theme id: default, warm, cool, mono, engineering, workbench, tactical, command, spacex, claude, codex, or inherit

name: render_svg
